extraction.Name: Jule Lamb
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want it, and did not take it for some time but that he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land, that it would be sold to pay them
extraction.Recorded patent: he did not have the patent recorded and does not know who did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: he thinks that he holds it yet
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land, that it would be sold to pay them
extraction.Occupation/Income: support is made by common labor and working on farms and ranches
extraction.NOTES: Deponent is a widower with two small children dependent on him for support and pays people for keeping them; bought a bunch of cattle on which he lost about $3000.00 on account of the drop in price; does not think his land was included in the mortgage on his cattle; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since his patent was issued; document sworn November 20, 1928
